t: Created when Ferdinand I divided his realms in 1065, Castile was ruled together with León for most of its history.
Alfonso VI's capture of Toledo in 1085 made Castile the leading Christian power and a centre of translation from Arabic.
Victory at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 opened al-Andalus, and union with León in 1230 created the Crown of Castile.
dyk: Henry I of Castile, king at ten, died in 1217 aged thirteen after being struck on the head by a roof tile while playing with other boys at the bishop's palace in Palencia.
ev: Ferdinand I's death leaves Castile to his eldest son Sancho II
Sancho II is murdered at Zamora and Alfonso VI reunites Castile and León
The Almoravids defeat Alfonso VI at the Battle of Sagrajas
Alfonso VII is crowned emperor in León
The Almohads defeat Alfonso VIII at the Battle of Alarcos
A Christian coalition destroys the Almohad army at Las Navas de Tolosa
Ferdinand III inherits León, creating the Crown of Castile
